description: Starkregengefahrenkarte Meerbusch WMS is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Stadt Meerbusch. This service contains the heavy rain map Meerbusch. There are the following scenarios: • Scenario 1: 30-year precipitation event (37mm in 60 min) • Scenario 2: 100-year precipitation event (46 mm in 60 min) • Scenario 3: 100 year precipitation event (90 mm in 60 min). Coverage: Stadt Meerbusch. The portal shows the English title as "Heavy rain hazard map Meerbusch WMS" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Stadt Meerbusch. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.govdata.de/dl-de/zero-2-0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
